about_the_game:
Prepare to embark on a dark and thrilling journey into Neverwards—a sprawling action RPG where danger lurks in every shadow, and the world shifts with each step you take.

Explore the ever-changing lands of Nevafall, from the scorching sands of burning deserts to the frozen wastelands of the icy west, and dense, ancient jungles brimming with untold secrets. No two journeys are alike, thanks to a fully randomized world generation system that ensures endless discovery and adventure.

Forge your destiny as a Paladin, Arcanist, Hunter, or Brawler, each boasting unique abilities and combat styles. Master the revolutionary Spell-Craft System, combining powerful spells to adapt your strategy to any challenge. Dive into the depths of infinite loot possibilities, where every chest, drop, and encounter holds the promise of game-changing gear.

Face relentless hordes of grotesque enemies, uncover long-lost relics, and unravel the dark mysteries of a cursed world where every choice shapes your fate. Neverwards is more than a game—it’s a test of courage, strategy, and resilience. Will you conquer the chaos and bring light to Nevafall, or succumb to the darkness, becoming just another shadow in the abyss?

In Neverwards, the adventure never truly ends—it only evolves.

Notable Features:

  • Randomized world generation

  • Infinite loot with over seven item rarities

  • 4 playable classes (with more to come)

  • Unique spell-crafting system (coming soon)

  • Dark, immersive world setting

  • Many Different Monsters

  • Unique Bosses

  • 6 Distinct Biomes

  • Rich lore collection to discover and read

Good luck on your journey, Hero!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 (4 cores) 3.6ghz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nivida GeForce GTX 750Ti
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-10505
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or Better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Enter a world where darkness consumes all. Choose your path as one of four powerful classes, mastering spells in a relentless battle against the damned. Unravel the mysteries of Nevafall, gather loot, and grow stronger. Will you conquer the abyss, or be lost to it forever?
